# Triplanar mapping

Wraps a texture around any shape without UVs: it is projected along the three axes and blended by how much the surface faces each, in world space (so it stays put while objects move) or object space (so it moves with them). A tile grid is built in.

<EffectDemo effect="triplanar" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { triplanar } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/triplanar';

const effect = triplanar({ preset: 'tiles' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.map = null`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                    | Default      | Range     | Description                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ----------------------- | ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `map`       | 2D texture              | `null`       |           | The texture to project (sRGB, set to repeat). Without one, a tile grid is used.                        |
| `scale`     | number                  | `2`          | 0.05 – 20 | Repeats per scene unit.                                                                                |
| `sharpness` | number                  | `4`          | 1 – 32    | How sharply the three projections blend: higher values give crisper seams.                             |
| `space`     | 'world' \| 'object'     | `'world'`    |           | Project in world space or in the object’s own space.                                                   |
| `mode`      | 'multiply' \| 'replace' | `'multiply'` |           | Multiply the texture into the lit color, or replace the color and keep only the lighting's brightness. |
| `colorA`    | hex color               | `'#c9c2b8'`  |           | Built-in tiles: first color.                                                                           |
| `colorB`    | hex color               | `'#8c8378'`  |           | Built-in tiles: second color.                                                                          |
| `amount`    | number                  | `1`          | 0 – 1     | Mix between the original color and the mapped one.                                                     |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                    |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tiles`   | `scale: 3`                                                  |
| `stuckOn` | `space: 'object'`                                           |
| `soft`    | `sharpness: 1.5`                                            |
| `painted` | `mode: 'replace'`, `colorA: '#e8d5b0'`, `colorB: '#4f7d8c'` |

Apply one with `triplanar({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.6 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/triplanar`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Matcap swap](./matcap) — Shades any material from a matcap: a picture of a lit sphere looked up by the surface direction, for clay, chrome or candy looks without lights.
- [Toon shading](./toon) — Cel shading on any lit material: the light snaps into flat bands (or follows a ramp you draw) while each surface keeps its color, the highlight becomes one flat spot, and an optional hard rim outlines the silhouette.
